# random

Generates random number. *(version 4.27 or later)*

```ttl
random <integer variable> <max number>
```

## Remarks

Generates random integer within the range 0..&lt;max number&gt; and assigns it to &lt;integer variable&gt;. The &lt;max number&gt; has to be greater than 0.

## Example

```ttl
; Variable val will contain integer within the range 0..100.
random val 100
```

```ttl
; random selection
while 1
	random val 10
	int2str valstr val
	statusbox valstr 'val'
	if val=0 then
		messagebox 'The val is zero.' 'test'
	elseif val<5 then
		messagebox 'The val is less than five.' 'test'
	else
		messagebox 'The val is greater than five.' 'test'
	endif
endwhile
```
